items.title: Walmart is determined not to make the same mistake with agentic commerce that it…

post.text:
Walmart is determined not to make the same mistake with agentic commerce that it did with ecommerce. While Amazon is blocking agents, Walmart is embracing them - quite a reversal.

And the new data from Stripe suggests agentic shopping may actually be kicking off & is sticky. https://t.co/IZPxb9VUou
